title: Three Months and One Short Page
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：pattern　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pattern 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the writer ① copyed the pattern that no reader in the study would have counted, and he said the copying was the whole of the month. The ② pattern, meaning the design itself and not the page, ran three months and stayed uncounted in the book; a pattern, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ pattern in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ pattern at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pattern, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the writer said the counting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pattern was the whole of the matter, meaning the rule and not the design. The ⑥ pattern, meaning the rule and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; pattern, he said, is either something you copy or the only word that means both a design and a rule. He said the rule is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ pattern had become a line in a manuscript, and the manuscript had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ pattern of the whole thing, the writer wrote in January, was one study and three months of counting; pattern, he said, is either the draft at the far shelf or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pattern I remember is the design counted in the manuscript, which closed in 1975 and is still counted as the quietest in the study. A ⑩ pattern, my mother said in 1977, is the only design that improves by being counted; every pattern, she said, is a rule that has agreed to look like a design. She said the rule was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 图案；模式（指书斋里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 图案；模式（指那种图案本身，与薄薄的书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：copy the pattern 照着画这一种图案
D. n. 图案；模式（指留给孩子们誊的那一份）
E. n. 图案之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的图案之事）
F. n. 图案；模式（指手稿里写到、被清点的那一种）
G. n. 图案、规律（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 规律（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: copyed the pattern that no reader in the study would have counted
The pattern, meaning the design itself and not the page
the pattern at the far shelf
the pattern was the whole of the matter
the pattern had become a line in a manuscript
The pattern of the whole thing
A pattern, my mother said in 1977

answers.why: copy the pattern 意为“照着画这一种图案”，1968 年那位写作者把书斋里没有一位读者肯清点的一种图案做了一遍。
pattern 意为“图案；模式”，指那种图案本身而不是薄薄的书页，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被清点。
pattern 意为“图案；模式”，指书斋里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
pattern 意为“图案；模式”，指最远那层书架的留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pattern 意为“图案、规律”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种规律就是那件事的全部。
pattern 意为“规律”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种图案，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pattern 意为“图案；模式”，指手稿里写到、被清点的那一种，到 1973 年这一种成了手稿里的一行。
pattern 意为“图案之事”，写作者一月写道，整件事的图案之事是一处书斋和三个月份的清点。
pattern 意为“图案；模式”，我记得的是手稿里清点过的那一种，1975 年写就了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一种。
pattern 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，图案是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的图案。
